name: Kisen
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 8); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: My home is near the Capital
poems.author: Kisen
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 8
poems.text:
My home is near the Capital,
My humble cottage bare
Lies south-east on Mount Uji; so
The people all declare
My life’s a ‘Hill of Care’.

poems.title: 8. わが庵は 都のたつみ しかぞ住む (Waga io wa miyako no tatsumi shika zo sumu)
poems.author: Kisen
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
わが庵は 都のたつみ しかぞ住む
世をうぢ山と 人はいふなり
